verdict.rationale: Gemini's own docs describe a user choice over whether audio, Gemini Live video and screenshares are used to train generative AI models. They also let users turn off Keep Activity and delete activity, and state that in some contexts chats and uploaded files are not used to improve models. The pack never explicitly ties the Keep Activity toggle to training on text chats, so control over typed conversations is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicit documented toggle linking text-chat activity settings to model training, clarity on which account types the no-training guarantee covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models

citations.quote: You can let Google use your audio and Gemini Live videos and screenshares to improve and develop its services, including training generative AI models.
You can review your prompts, delete your Gemini Apps activity, and turn off Keep Activity in My Activity at any time.
Your chats and uploaded files in Gemini Apps won’t be reviewed by human reviewers or otherwise used to improve generative AI models.
